tooltip.infinitygauntlet.gauntlet.hint: Right-click a stone onto the gauntlet to install it (empty cursor removes one). Use to cast; V/C cycles abilities, G cycles stones, hold R for the wheel.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.space: Housed in the Tesseract. Bends space itself.
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.mind: Telekinesis and dominion over minds. (Awakens in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.reality: Rewrites matter and perception. (Awakens in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.power: Raw cosmic destruction. (Awakens in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.time: Freezes, slows and rewinds time. (Awakens in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.soul: Life, spirit and spectral guardians. (Awakens in a future update)
tooltip.infinitygauntlet.stone.install: Right-click it onto an Infinity Gauntlet in your inventory, or sneak-use the gauntlet with the stone in your off hand.
screen.infinitygauntlet.wheel.hint: Inner ring: stone · Outer ring: ability · Release to select
message.infinitygauntlet.no_stones: The gauntlet is empty. Install an Infinity Stone first.
message.infinitygauntlet.stone_dormant: The %s Stone's power has not awakened yet.
message.infinitygauntlet.portal.anchored: Rupture anchored. Cast again anywhere to open its twin.
message.infinitygauntlet.portal.cross_di: Cross-dimension ruptures are disabled on this server.
message.infinitygauntlet.swap.anchored: %s anchored. Cast at another target (or at nothing) to swap.
message.infinitygauntlet.swap.no_target: Aim at a creature, or sneak-cast to place a marker.
message.infinitygauntlet.gateway.no_sky: Not enough open sky above the target.
message.infinitygauntlet.prison.sealed: %s is sealed in a spatial prison.
message.infinitygauntlet.waypoint.invali: The waypoint's dimension no longer exists.
ability.infinitygauntlet.dimensional_por: Open a dimensional rupture where you aim. Cast twice to link a pair, even across dimensions. Sneak-cast to collapse your ruptures.
ability.infinitygauntlet.spatial_rift.de: Tear a rift beneath your target. It drags in creatures and objects and spits them out high above.
ability.infinitygauntlet.blink.desc: Dissolve into spatial energy and reappear a short distance ahead.
Open orbiting portals that track enemies and fire bolts of folded space.
ability.infinitygauntlet.spatial_compres: A sphere that crushes space inward, pulling everything in before exploding outward.
Exchange the positions of two creatures, a creature and a marker, or yourself and an anchored target. Sneak-cast to place a marker.
Tear an enormous rupture into the sky above the battlefield, linked to one before you. Whatever enters falls from the sky.
Suspend a creature inside six rotating portal rings.
ability.infinitygauntlet.universal_telep: Carry yourself and nearby allies to your waypoint (sneak-cast to set it) or to where you aim.
advancement.infinitygauntlet.root.desc: Obtain an Infinity Gauntlet or an Infinity Stone
advancement.infinitygauntlet.tesseract.d: Install the Space Stone into a gauntlet
advancement.infinitygauntlet.between_wor: Travel through a rupture into another dimension
